reason: A Windows-focused DSH plugin that lets users arm automatic shutdown after all root sessions complete successfully, with a visible cancellable countdown and cancellation on new work.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 的 DSH 插件，可在用户手动开启后于任务完成时启动可取消的自动关机倒计时。
summaries.en: A Windows DSH plugin that users can arm to start a cancellable automatic shutdown countdown when tasks finish.

capabilities: Monitors task and agent status events
Executes Windows shutdown after a configurable countdown
Cancels a pending shutdown through a local HTTP endpoint or new task activity
Injects a browser UI control and countdown banner
